title: Chapter 392 Crocodile Man
content:
Chapter 392 Crocodile Man

Li Jianguo immediately ordered the bronze crossbow cart to start shooting the monsters that jumped onto the top of the city.

At the same time, Lin Dabiao, Gong Zheng, Ayub and other generals also began to attack the bosses around them.

A melee unfolded on the city wall.

In this battle, high-end combat power will play a decisive role.

The monster bosses' first target of attack is the powerful catapult and bronze crossbow cart.

After Wang Shuo discovered this, he was horrified. If there were no support from these two powerful weapons.

His generals could not stop the boss on the opposite side at all. After all, the number of bosses among the monsters was really too many.

A rough estimate is that there are thousands of them.

And there are also a large number of elite monsters.

Just when Wang Shuo wanted to support a nearby catapult.

The war general boss on the opposite side finally rushed to the city wall.

Wang Shuo did not dare to be careless and immediately confronted him.

Like Apache, this crocodile boss also has a crocodile head, which looks a bit funny, like a doll.

But if you underestimate him, you will have to pay a high price, after all, the crocodile boss is as powerful as a human warrior.

"You are Wang Shuo, right? I have heard of you."

The crocodile boss spoke in human language and looked at Wang Shuo with interest.

"Sir, where have you heard of me?"

Wang Shuo was also a little curious.

While talking, Wang Shuo had already rushed towards the crocodile man with the Bloodthirsty Gun in his hand.

After Wang Shuo returned to the territory, he had already repaired the Bloodthirsty Gun. In the Warrior Tower, the Bloodthirsty Gun was almost scrapped.

At this time, he already felt that the Bloodthirsty Gun could not keep up with his pace.

After this battle, it was necessary to rebuild a set of equipment.

The crocodile man blocked Wang Shuo's spear with his hand, and snorted: "Don't you know the crimes you have committed?"

Wang Shuo talked nonsense with him just to distract his attention. As for the crocodiles he had killed, he was too lazy to count them.

The crocodile man was covered with thick scales, which were no less than human armor, and more close to the body, and did not affect his movements at all.

Wang Shuo's weeping blood spear, whipped on it, only rubbed sparks, and did not cause any substantial damage.

This made Wang Shuo feel a little uncomfortable. Obviously, the crocodile man's defense has reached an extremely terrifying level.

Wang Shuo can be said to have suffered a great loss.

The crocodile man's two arms also have sharp claws, and the hardness is comparable to rare weapons.

Wang Shuo immediately used a solid talisman, which was exchanged in Shanhai City. It can increase the defense of weapons or armor by 50%, and the duration is only half an hour. At the same time, a sharp talisman was used to increase the attack power of the weapon.

After fighting against the crocodile man for more than ten minutes, Wang Shuo was always in a passive position.

Fortunately, Wang Shuo had a lot of water of life, so he could hold on for so long.

Seeing this, Gong Zheng and Ayub killed the opponent at the fastest speed and hurried to support Wang Shuo.

Then Ye Tianba and Gude also joined the battle.

Wang Shuo was a little worried that so many senior generals would be dragged down by a general on the opposite side, which would affect the overall situation, but then he thought that as long as he took down this crocodile man, this local war would be won, and it would be worth it.

After more people, everyone cooperated and finally suppressed the crocodile man.

Wang Shuo used an "iron chain binding" to control the crocodile man for 1 second, and the crocodile man was hit by a big move of a group of generals.

But it didn't cause much damage.

The crocodile man roared, and his body suddenly swelled.

Originally, his body was similar to that of an ordinary human. After the swell, he became a crocodile man of more than three meters, just like Gong Zheng after the transformation.

At this moment, Wang Shuo had an absurd picture in his mind.

Crocodile man vs. stone man.
